name: 129.2 — the edge rule names the vocabulary that ships
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 129.2: every key the edge rule now names is a key the bus takes, spelled exactly as the rule writes it -- the threshold crossed, the two selections, the four clicks and the two moments that are their own word -- each ended by sub:off(); while a near miss in the session family is refused naming the family, and a click key bent to one of the three edges is not a key at all.
